crossRefs.note: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like…
Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh…
of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

people.name: Hymenaeus
people.line: A man who rejected faith and good conscience.

translations.web: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
translations.bsb: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
translations.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
translations.asv: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: or whom is Hymenaeus an Philetus;
